g.text: This cluster shows HIGH confidence for ribosome biogenesis and 40S small ribosomal subunit assembly.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Over 75% of genes are established components: 22 ribosomal proteins (RPS family), 13 SSU

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: processome/pre-rRNA processing factors (UTP, BMS1, PNO1, etc.), 5 translation initiation factors

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: (EIF3 complex), and supporting factors (POLR1B for rRNA transcription, XPO1 for nuclear export,

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2937

font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2937

g.text: RPS20, RPS8, RPS7, RPS12, RPS13, RPS23, RPS19, RPS10, RPS24, RPS9, RPS3A, RPS14,

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2937

g.text: RPS26, RPS2, RPS15, RPS15A, RPS17, RPS5, RPS21, RPS11, RPSA, FAU, PNO1, UTP11, BMS1,

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2937

g.text: PDCD11, BYSL, RCL1, HEATR1, LTV1, UTP15, UTP20, DHX37, DDX21, UTP14A, BUD23, NOP14,

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2937

g.text: WDR43, EIF3B, EIF3A, EIF3CL, EIF3G, EIF3C, POLR1B, RIOK2, AATF, XPO1

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2937

font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d4ed8
font-style: italic; font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9ca3af
font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: BBSome component required for primary cilia assembly and microtubule stability. While unexpected in

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: this cluster, some ribosomal proteins have ciliary functions. Connection may be indirect through

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d4ed8
font-style: italic; font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9ca3af
font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: RNA helicase with established roles in R-loop resolution and pluripotency maintenance. While it has

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: some connection to nucleolar function and rDNA loci, its role in ribosome biogenesis is partially

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d4ed8
font-style: italic; font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9ca3af
font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: RNA helicase primarily characterized in innate immunity and inflammasome activation. No established

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: role in ribosome biogenesis, but DDX family helicases are known to function in RNA processing.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d4ed8
font-style: italic; font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9ca3af
font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Involved in transcriptional regulation and SLC2A4 processing. Limited characterization overall.

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Potential role in regulating ribosomal gene transcription, but function remains unclear.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d4ed8
font-style: italic; font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9ca3af
font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Coactivator for mitochondrial biogenesis and CREB/NRF1 targets. While it regulates transcription

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: related to cell growth, no direct link to ribosome biogenesis is established. May coordinate

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d4ed8
font-style: italic; font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9ca3af
font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Core component of APC/C ubiquitin ligase controlling cell cycle progression. No established role in

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: ribosome biogenesis. May regulate stability of ribosome biogenesis factors or coordinate ribosome

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d4ed8
font-style: italic; font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9ca3af
font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Known as transcriptional regulator (NF-kappa-B, serum response element), but limited functional

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: characterization overall. No established role in ribosome biogenesis. May regulate transcription of

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Bitstream Vera Sans Mono', 'Computer Modern Typewriter', 'Andale Mono', 'Nimbus Mono L', 'Courier New', 'Courier', 'Fixed', 'Terminal', monospace; text-anchor: start; fill: #1d4ed8
font-style: italic; font-size: 4.5px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9ca3af
font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Fusion gene or readthrough transcript with minimal characterization. RPS10 component is established

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Myriad Pro', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: in ribosome function, but the fusion product's role is unclear.
